common.name: Name

tips.draft: Prepared by the system from the registration. It has no invoice number yet and nobody outside has seen it.
tips.pending: Waiting for you. When you approve it, the number is assigned, the PDF is written and it can no longer be changed.
tips.sent: Approved and emailed, with the fact sheet attached. Corrections only through a credit note.
tips.overdue: The due date has passed and the money has not arrived. You can send a reminder from Payments.
tips.classroom: Whether this person had an active Classroom membership. Active means 30% off the course price.
tips.snapshot: The discount is decided on the day of registration and never recalculated. If the membership expires later, the price already granted stays.
tips.grouped: Several participants on one invoice for the same company. Each line keeps that person's own discount.
tips.prereq: Whether the required earlier education is on record. A missing one never blocks — it is only shown.
tips.waitlist: When the event is full, registrations still arrive and land here in order. Nobody moves up automatically — you confirm it.
tips.licence: Belongs to the person and never changes, even if the certificate is reissued. This is the number a coach publishes.
tips.certno: Belongs to the document. Reissuing after a name change produces a new certificate number, the licence number stays.
tips.codes: A code is proof by itself: you have it because you were there, or because Robert sent it to you. A dropdown of events would be a self-declaration the system cannot check.
tips.stack: By default the better of the two discounts applies, not both. A member with 30% who enters a 10% code still gets 30%. Robert can allow combining per code.
tips.claim: For promises made before codes existed. Nothing is applied automatically — it lands with Gudrun as a task to check.
tips.personal: Made by Robert on his phone the moment he promises somebody a discount. One use, sent by WhatsApp from the system. The code carries the identity, so nobody has to match names later.
tips.ownership: Every piece of data has exactly one owner. If something looks wrong, fix it where it lives — the other side follows within a minute. Fixing a copy is overwritten by the next sync.
tips.syncfail: A change that did not reach the other side is retried automatically for 24 hours. It never disappears: it stays here and on Today until it succeeds or you resolve it.
tips.fixedprice: This event has a fixed price. No discount of any kind applies here — not the Classroom discount, not a code, not an individual one. A code entered here is refused but stays valid for other events.
tips.transfer: The place goes to another person for the same event, free of charge, until 7 days before. Invoice and payments stay with the original billing recipient; the two settle privately. Certificate and history go to the new participant.
tips.health: Required from every participant at least 72 hours before check-in. Without it a transferred place is not valid. The system does not judge the content — it only records whether it was submitted and when.
tips.onePerPerson: A campaign code can be used many times, but only once per person. Robert promised one training of their choice, not one per training.
tips.received: The date the participant sent the cancellation, not the date you opened the email. The fee band is calculated from this date.
tips.bands: From your Terms & Conditions. "More than 60 days" is read as 60 days or more, so day 60 does not fall between two rules. Percentages are of the total ticket price, not of the amount paid.
tips.deposit: 50% at booking, the balance invoiced 30 days before the start — the day the 100% cancellation band begins — and due seven days before. Registrations made inside 30 days are invoiced in full at once.
tips.licvalid: The certificate proves the education was completed and never expires. The licence is the right to teach and has to be renewed. Two dates, two meanings.
tips.verify: Anyone can check this number on the website and see the name, the education and the date. Revoked certificates show as invalid.
tips.expiring: Active today but ending within 30 days. This is the list to work through, not the expired one.
tips.manual: Opened by hand rather than paid online. These are the ones that used to be forgotten and never closed.
tips.toverify: Somebody claims instructor status. Until you confirm it, no Classroom discount is given.

members.someFailed_other: {{count}} people could not be read from the website.

sync.sub: Every change the back office sent to the website, and every document it sent. Newest first.
sync.empty: Nothing has been sent to the website yet.
sync.rule: The one rule: fix data where it lives. Prices, dates and course texts on the website; certificates and hand-issued invoices here. The back office keeps no copy of website data — it reads it live.

events.what: Events, courses, programmes — dates, prices, member prices, places

purchases.what: Purchases of events and courses, their invoices
purchases.cms: Reads orders and PDFs, sends them, refunds through WooCommerce.

attendees.what: Named participants on a company order
attendees.cms: Gudrun types the names; they are stored on the order line on the website.

memberships.cms: Reads; cancels at period end / now / with refund; sends checkout links.

freeAccess.what: Free access with an end date
freeAccess.cms: Grants it; the website ends it on the date.

licences.cms: Adds, verifies, rejects, revokes; the website stores them and unlocks lessons only with licence AND membership.

codes.cms: Creates them; the website checks and expires them.

certificates.cms: Issues them; the licence number on the website is the same number.

handInvoices.what: Invoices issued by hand, credit notes, bank-transfer refunds
handInvoices.cms: Owns them — never on the website.

audit.what: The log of every change and every send
